2608.16620.title: Palmyra x6 Technical Report: An Agentic, Tool-Use Model Post-Trained via Anchored Supervised Fine-Tuning
2608.16620.paper_summary: Palmyra x6 is a large language model optimized for use with enterprise-oriented agentic tasks. The model was built by post-training a Mixture-of-Experts base model with Anchored Supervised Fine-Tuning on a compact corpus of verified, synthetic tool-use trajectories, optimized with a Muon + Adam hybrid. The recipe is deliberately conservative and deliberately controlled: 626 trajectories, a single epoch, a low learning rate, and a KL anchor to the frozen base. The model shows substantial gains over the previous default model for Writer Agent, and compares favorably with several recent models on public benchmarks, scoring the highest on BFCL Core at $0.785$ and posts the highest six-benchmark mean of the cohort. Furthermore, the model has shown itself to be competitive or leading relative to comparators in our bias and safety evaluations.
2608.16620.paper_summary_zh: Palmyra x6 是一個大型語言模型，專為企業導向的代理任務而優化。該模型是通過在一個經過驗證的合成工具使用軌跡的緊湊語料庫上進行錨定監督微調，對 Mixture-of-Experts 基礎模型進行後訓練而構建的，並使用 Muon + Adam 混合優化。這個配方故意保守且受到控制：626 條軌跡、一個訓練週期、低學習率，以及對凍結基礎的 KL 錨定。該模型在 Writer Agent 的表現上顯著超越了之前的默認模型，並在公共基準上與幾個最近的模型相比表現良好，在 BFCL Core 上得分最高為 $0.785$，並在該組中發佈了最高的六項基準均值。此外，該模型在我們的偏見和安全評估中顯示出與比較對手的競爭力或領先地位。
